title: No-JS delete has no confirmation
notes: No confirmation dialog when JavaScript is disabled – accidental deletes are harder to recover from.
candidate_fix: Add optional confirmation page or soft-delete with undo window

title: Limited feedback for no-JS filtering
evidence: Filter changes rely on full page reload and text result count only.
notes: Consider stronger visual emphasis or summary panel for filtered state

title: No success feedback after add task in No-JS mode
evidence: wk09/data/pilot-notes.md P4; wk09/analysis/findings.md Theme 1; wk09/analysis/evidence-chains.md Chain 1
notes: PRG redirect shows no confirmation message. P4 said 'I think it worked but there is no confirmation'. Confidence 3/5 for T3.
candidate_fix: Add flash message or success banner to No-JS add flow

title: Edit save confirmation not prominent enough
evidence: wk09/data/pilot-notes.md P1-P4; wk09/analysis/findings.md Theme 2; wk09/analysis/evidence-chains.md Chain 2
notes: 4/5 participants expressed uncertainty after saving. Status message too subtle. P4 confidence 2/5 for T2.
candidate_fix: Enhance status message visibility with larger text or visual highlight

title: No-JS edit error message not keyboard-focusable
notes: Error appears at top of page but focus remains at form. P4 had to scroll up to find error. WCAG 3.3.1 and 2.4.3.
candidate_fix: Add tabindex=-1 to error summary and focus on page load

title: Filter input not immediately discoverable
notes: P2 took 30 seconds to find filter. Suggested adding label or placeholder.
candidate_fix: Add placeholder text or visible label to filter input

title: Focus management after delete could be improved
notes: After delete focus moves to next item without announcement. P3 noted slight disorientation. WCAG 2.4.3.
candidate_fix: Consider announcing deletion and new focus location via aria-live
